newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia allows banks to cross-trade currencies.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia allows banks to cross-trade currencies.

text.p: Tunisia, within the framework of the liberalisation of the foreign exchange market, on Monday allowed domestic banks to start exchanging hard currencies with foreign financial institutions, the Central Bank of Tunisia (BCT) said.

In a circular sent to the banks on Monday and obtained by Reuters, BCT said resident banks "were authorised to trade foreign currencies between them, with their foreign correspondents and with non-resident banks in Tunisia."
It says the decision was with immediate effect.
